eyebrow: The T-SQL Development Course · Chapter Six
subtitle: Lesson 52 · Subqueries, CTEs, and Views

code:
SELECT Name, ListPrice
FROM Production.Product
WHERE ListPrice >
  (SELECT AVG(ListPrice) FROM Production.Product);
caption: The inner query computes ONE number — products priced above that average.

eyebrow: Anywhere a single value is expected
code:
SELECT Name, ListPrice,
  (SELECT AVG(ListPrice) FROM Production.Product)
    AS OverallAverage
FROM Production.Product;
caption: Even inside the SELECT list — every row shows the same overall average.

subtitle: When the subquery returns more than one value.
